scope: Source inspection and recomputation of saved prediction scores. No new model inference or independent reproduction. No changes to published report in this audit.

findings.issue: Explicit decision policy, Qwen-specific letter instructions copied into CLM state, Qwen-directed development, one held-out course. Same information did not ensure appropriate interfaces or equal development.

Designed after observing the primary test. Removed the synthetic NO_TOOL choice for both models on all 60 positive requests. All eligible positive requests included; not selected individually by model correctness. CLM prose also tested (35/60 versus JSON 40/60); Qwen 55/60. Report should identify post-result design next to headline.

All 24 CLM choices were NO_TOOL; 12 abstentions happened to be correct. Qwen 21/24. Prose CLM variant omitted despite improving primary 90-request result from 30 to 40 correct. Six shared function sets, 24 distinct requests, no request-ID overlap with development/test cases.

findings.status: Not supported as a general improvement
findings.issue: Longer Qwen prompt scored 78/90 versus short prompt 79/90; repeated requests 20/24 versus 21/24.

findings.status: No analogous letter-output instruction mismatch found in inspected CLM path
findings.issue: CLM uses repository build_pairs: passage plus question, separate plain answer texts. Qwen baseline 174/200 and CLM 67/200. Qwen layout selected on separate development data; later seven-layout ablations reuse test set, so best 181/200 is exploratory, not fresh-test validation. Does not establish optimal CLM prompting or absence of public-data training contamination.

findings.status: No evaluation-key insertion found in inspected prompt constructors
findings.issue: Same source passage/question/options with native CLM serialization. Limited filtered samples, not full leaderboard scores. Weak results and no-document controls preclude broad comprehension claims.
No graph-distance or preferred-link labels passed to model inputs in inspected code. Five route trials, at most eight clicks; not full-article reading or a reproduction of authors benchmark.

findings.status: Sanity checks, not independent game-decision evidence
findings.issue: Several observations explicitly state the successful move, such as a jump right reaches the goal. Separate from actual emulator experiments.

BFCL headline uses five warm repetitions on ten same requests, excluding both methods cache setup. Separate repeated-request test demonstrates cache reuse on changing questions. CLM cold action embeddings computed sequentially; not optimized batched serving. RACE ablations cache CLM action vectors while Qwen reads full prompt. No general end-to-end or serving-latency equivalence established.
